BaseDestroyed.en: Base {1} has been destroyed. Move to another base!
BaseDestroyed.chi: 基地{1}已被摧毁, 请转移到其他基地!

FacilityMaximumLevel.en: This structure is already at its maximum level.
FacilityMaximumLevel.chi: 此设施已经达到最高等级.

FacilityUpgradeRecipeMissing.en: No upgrade recipe is configured for this structure.
FacilityUpgradeRecipeMissing.chi: 此设施未配置升级配方.

UpgradePersonalMaterialsMissing.en: Your backpack lacks upgrade materials. Withdraw supplies from a base warehouse.
UpgradePersonalMaterialsMissing.chi: 个人升级材料不足, 可从基地共享仓库取出物资.

DefenseLimitReached.en: The team has reached the limit of {1} defensive structures.
DefenseLimitReached.chi: 团队防御设施数量已达上限{1}.

BuildPlacementUnavailable.en: Choose another spot: this location lacks space, has uneven ground, or blocks a protected spawn.
BuildPlacementUnavailable.chi: 此处空间不足, 地面不平或位于出生保护区, 请调整位置.

BuildPersonalMaterialsMissing.en: Your backpack lacks construction materials. Withdraw supplies from a base warehouse.
BuildPersonalMaterialsMissing.chi: 个人建造材料不足, 可从基地共享仓库取出物资.

DefenseBuilt.en: Built {1}. Aim at the structure and press E to upgrade it.
DefenseBuilt.chi: 已建造{1}. 瞄准设施按E可升级.

DayStarted.en: Day {1}: a few zombies are roaming. Gather supplies and improve your base. Night begins in {2} seconds.
DayStarted.chi: 第{1}天白天: 少量丧尸游荡, 出门采集并修建基地. 距离黑夜{2}秒.

NightStarted.en: Night {1}: enter a base safety zone! Outside the zone, lose {3} health every {2} seconds.
NightStarted.chi: 第{1}天黑夜: 请进入基地安全区! 区外每{2}秒损失{3}点生命.

CampaignVictory.en: You defeated the Boss. This map has been cleared!
CampaignVictory.chi: 你战胜了Boss, 本地图已经肃清!

CampaignLoss.en: You have failed. The zombies control this place.
CampaignLoss.chi: 你失败了, 此地已被丧尸统治.

CampaignRollbackDestroy.en: Defense failed. Returning to day {1}. Base upgrades are retained; summoned defenses are cleared.
CampaignRollbackDestroy.chi: 防守失败, 回到第{1}天. 基地升级保留, 召唤物已清空.

CampaignRollbackRetain.en: Defense failed. Returning to day {1}. Base upgrades are retained; surviving defenses will be rebuilt next round.
CampaignRollbackRetain.chi: 防守失败, 回到第{1}天. 基地升级保留, 存活设施将在下一回合重建.

SafeSpawnOccupied.en: Safe spawn points are occupied. Head to a surviving base as soon as possible.
SafeSpawnOccupied.chi: 安全出生点暂被占用, 请尽快前往存活基地.

NightApproaching.en: Night is approaching. Return to a base safety zone!
NightApproaching.chi: 黑夜即将到来, 请赶回基地安全区!
